messages.subject: Okafor — first read of the redundancy file
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

I've been through the redundancy paperwork and the 2024 file. Two things worry me:

1. Timeline. Disclosures June–July 2024 -> removed from safeguarding group 15 July -> 'performance review' opened 12 Aug -> provisional redundancy selection 9 Dec. A tribunal will see that sequence and ask questions.

2. The scorer. Lorna Keane scored the selection matrix and she's the person Priya complained to. That's not a good look for an automatic-unfair claim where the burden is effectively on us.

On the plus side: the redundancy situation itself looks genuine (two block contracts lost, Board decision 19 Nov to merge East/Central), there was a proper pool of three, individual consultation, and an alternative role was offered. Mr Rahman — not a subject of the disclosures — was the dismissing officer, which helps on causation.

I'll draft the ET3 to admit redundancy as the reason and deny the disclosures were the principal reason. Worth getting Harriet Vance's view early.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
